summary: DUKE Robotics Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement with Maxim Group LLC for a public offering of 1,125,000 units at $8.20 per unit, each consisting of one share of common stock and a warrant to purchase one share at $8.60 for five years. The underwriter partially exercised an over-allotment for warrants on 168,750 shares. The offering closed on May 18, 2026, generating aggregate gross proceeds of $9.225M. Proceeds will fund R&D, sales, marketing, business development, potential acquisitions, and working capital. This is a routine capital raise through an underwritten public offering, not a special situation.
